# contenir-db-model

> PHP 8.3+ data mapper built on php-db/phpdb 0.6. Entities are plain classes with typed properties, mapped with attributes from `Contenir\Db\Model\Mapping`. There are no base classes and no magic accessors. Version 2.x is a ground-up rewrite and is incompatible with 1.x, which used AbstractEntity, __get/__set, $columns arrays and laminas-db.

Key facts for code generation:

- An entity needs `#[Table('name')]` and at least one `#[Id]`. Only properties with `#[Column]`, `#[Id]` or `#[Version]` are persisted.
- Column names default to the property name exactly, with no snake_case conversion. Use `#[Column('created_at')]` to map a different column name.
- Relation keys are column names. `HasOne`/`HasMany` take `foreignKey` (a target column). `BelongsTo` takes `foreignKey` (a column on this entity). `ManyToMany` takes `via: new Via(table, foreignKey:, relatedKey:)`.
- `#[Version]` must be a non-nullable `int`. Generated ids and versions cannot be `readonly`.
- Invalid mappings throw `Contenir\Db\Model\Exception\MappingException` when metadata is first built.
- Use `CachedMetadataFactory` (PSR-16) in production. Clear its cache on deploy.
- Types: `int`/`float`/`string`/`bool`, any `BackedEnum` and any `DateTimeInterface` convert automatically. `array` needs `#[Column(type: 'json')]`. A date-only column uses `#[Column(type: 'date')]`. Custom converters go through `TypeRegistry::withDefaults()->withConverter($nameOrClass, $converter)`.
- A database NULL loaded into a non-nullable property throws `TypeConversionException`. Declare nullable columns as `?type`.

## Docs

- [Mapping entities](docs/mapping.md): every attribute and parameter, key defaults, validation rules, and the EntityMetadata API
- [Metadata caching](docs/metadata-caching.md): CachedMetadataFactory, cache keys, failure behaviour, invalidation
- [Type conversion](docs/types.md): built-in converters and their accepted inputs, resolution order, nulls, custom converters

## Source

- [Mapping attributes](src/Mapping/): Table, Column, Id, Version, HasOne, HasMany, BelongsTo, ManyToMany, Via
- [Metadata](src/Metadata/): AttributeMetadataFactory, CachedMetadataFactory, EntityMetadata, FieldMetadata, RelationMetadata
- [Types](src/Type/): TypeRegistry, TypeConverterInterface and the built-in converters
- [Exceptions](src/Exception/): ExceptionInterface, InvalidArgumentException, RuntimeException, MappingException, TypeConversionException, StaleEntityException

## Optional

- [Test fixtures](tests/TestAsset/Entity/): small example entities (User, Order, Profile, Tag, Membership) covering every mapping feature
